name: IRONWALL OPEN: Full-Chrome Combat Football S1
description: Founded by Cascadia Iron and HelixCorp as a showcase for military-grade augmentation, IRONWALL OPEN pits fully chromed athletes in a brutal field sport where titanium-reinforced tackles routinely crater the playing surface. Athletes average 340kg of augmented mass and routinely exceed 80kph sprint speeds, making standard protective equipment laughably inadequate. The league's founding season ended with three players requiring full skeletal replacement, a fact HelixCorp marketed as proof of concept.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 athlete is recruited into the league but discovers her corporate-sponsored augmentations contain hidden behavioral suppression hardware.
An investigative feed journalist uncovers that three 'retired' IRONWALL players were actually decommissioned — their augments repossessed and bodies abandoned in Shelf medical dumps.
A rogue referee begins feeding match data to underground betting syndicates, and someone wants them silenced before the playoffs.
